learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to classify engineering fields of activity based on concrete tasks.
Students are able to describe technical and operational processes of a company with an industrial focus.
Students are able to apply knowledge, methods, and procedures acquired during their studies to practical tasks.
Students are able to independently plan and implement contributions to projects with a professional reference to their studies.
Students are able to reflect on the connections between study content and practical work and present them comprehensibly in the internship report.

syllabus_topics: Insight into technical, organizational, and operational processes of a company with an industrial focus
Independent collaboration on projects that are closely related professionally to the completed studies or represent a valuable addition
Application and deepening of knowledge, methods, and procedures taught in theoretical studies
Documentation and reflection of practical work, and presentation of its interlinking with study content in the internship report
Dual students complete the internship as part of the practical study semester in accordance with the regulations in the APO THI and the coordination between THI and the practical partner
